def sasa(atoms,n=200,probe=1.4):
    gr=(1+5**.5)/2; i=np.arange(n); y=1-2*(i+.5)/n
    rr=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-y*y)); th=2*np.pi*i/gr
    sp0=np.stack([np.cos(th)*rr,y,np.sin(th)*rr],1)
    X=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in atoms]); R=np.array([VDW.get(a['el'].upper(),1.7) for a in atoms])+probe
    tree=cKDTree(X); out=np.zeros(len(atoms))
    for k in range(len(atoms)):
        nb=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(X[k],R[k]+R.max()) if j!=k]
        sp=X[k]+sp0*R[k]; acc=np.ones(n,bool)
        for j in nb: acc&=(np.linalg.norm(sp-X[j],axis=1)>=R[j])
        out[k]=4*np.pi*R[k]**2*acc.sum()/n
    return out

def kabsch(P,Q):
    P=np.asarray(P,float);Q=np.asarray(Q,float);pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    U,_,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc)); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc

def dp(sc,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=sc.shape; F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        f1,f0=F[i-1],F[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=f1[j-1]+sc[i-1,j-1];b=f1[j]+gap;c=f0[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: f0[j]=a;P[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: f0[j]=b;P[i,j]=1
            else: f0[j]=c;P[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def salign(A,B,sa_,sb_,it=12):
    Ax=np.array([x for _,x in A]);Bx=np.array([x for _,x in B])
    R,t=kabsch(sa_,sb_); L=min(len(A),len(B)); d0=max(1.24*(max(L,19)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5); best=None
    for _ in range(it):
        An=(R@Ax.T).T+t; Dm=np.linalg.norm(An[:,None]-Bx[None],axis=2)
        pr=dp(1/(1+(Dm/d0)**2)); sel=[(i,j) for i,j in pr if Dm[i,j]<6]
        if len(sel)<4: break
        R,t=kabsch(Ax[[i for i,_ in sel]],Bx[[j for _,j in sel]])
        An=(R@Ax.T).T+t; D2=np.linalg.norm(An[:,None]-Bx[None],axis=2)
        tm=sum(1/(1+(D2[i,j]/d0)**2) for i,j in pr)/L
        core=[(i,j) for i,j in pr if D2[i,j]<5]
        cand=dict(tm=tm,core=core,rmsd=float(np.sqrt(np.mean([D2[i,j]**2 for i,j in core]))))
        if best is None or tm>best['tm']: best=cand
    return best

def charge_pts(atoms):
    byres={}
    for a in atoms: byres.setdefault((a['ch'],a['resi'],a['resn']),{})[a['name']]=a['xyz']
    q=[]
    for (ch,ri,rn),nm in byres.items():

        elif rn=='LYS' and 'NZ' in nm: q.append((nm['NZ'],1.0))
        elif rn=='ASP' and 'CG' in nm: q.append((nm['CG'],-1.0))
        elif rn=='GLU' and 'CD' in nm: q.append((nm['CD'],-1.0))
        elif rn=='HIS' and 'CE1' in nm: q.append((nm['CE1'],0.1))
    return q
def surf_stats(atoms,name):
    sa=sasa(atoms)
    gr=(1+5**.5)/2; n=120; i=np.arange(n); y=1-2*(i+.5)/n
    rr=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-y*y)); th=2*np.pi*i/gr
    sp0=np.stack([np.cos(th)*rr,y,np.sin(th)*rr],1)
    X=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in atoms]); R=np.array([VDW.get(a['el'].upper(),1.7) for a in atoms])+1.4
    tree=cKDTree(X); dots=[]
    for k in range(len(atoms)):
        nb=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(X[k],R[k]+R.max()) if j!=k]
        sp=X[k]+sp0*R[k]; acc=np.ones(n,bool)
        for j in nb: acc&=(np.linalg.norm(sp-X[j],axis=1)>=R[j])
        if acc.any(): dots.append(sp[acc])
    dots=np.vstack(dots)
    q=charge_pts(atoms); Q=np.array([c for _,c in q]); QX=np.array([x for x,_ in q])
    Dm=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(dots[:,None]-QX[None],axis=2),2.0)
    pot=(332.0*(Q[None,:]/(4*Dm*Dm))).sum(1)/0.593
    sby={}
    for a,s in zip(atoms,sa): sby[(a['ch'],a['resi'],a['resn'])]=sby.get((a['ch'],a['resi'],a['resn']),0)+s
    tot=sum(sby.values()); aas=[AA3[k[2]] for k in sby]
    return dict(structure=name,n_res=len(sby),
        net_charge=sum(1 for c in aas if c in 'KR')-sum(1 for c in aas if c in 'DE'),
        frac_surface_basic=round(sum(v for k,v in sby.items() if k[2] in ('ARG','LYS'))/tot,3),
        frac_surface_acidic=round(sum(v for k,v in sby.items() if k[2] in ('ASP','GLU'))/tot,3),

def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def nw_fast(qa,ta,g=-8.0):
    n,m=len(qa),len(ta)
    Sc=B62[np.clip(qa,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(ta,0,19)[None,:]]; Sc[qa<0,:]=-2; Sc[:,ta<0]=-2
    ar=np.arange(m+1); M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); FR=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); KS=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int32)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pv=M[i-1]; diag=pv[:-1]+Sc[i-1]; up=pv[1:]+g
        a=np.empty(m+1); a[0]=pv[0]+g; a[1:]=np.maximum(diag,up)
        fr=np.zeros(m+1,np.int8); fr[0]=1; fr[1:]=np.where(diag>=up,0,1)
        v=a-g*ar; run=np.maximum.accumulate(v)
        ksv=np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(v>=run-1e-9,ar,-1))
        M[i]=run+g*ar; FR[i]=np.where(ksv==ar,fr,2); KS[i]=ksv
    j=int(np.argmax(M[n])); aln=np.full(n,-1,int); i=n
    while i>0 and j>=0:
        f=FR[i,j]
        if f==2: j=int(KS[i,j]); continue
        if f==0: aln[i-1]=j-1; i-=1; j-=1
        else: i-=1
    return aln

def largest_cluster(ids,cut=10.0):

    X=np.array([res[p]['cen'] for p in ids]); n=len(X); adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[j])<cut: adj[i].append(j); adj[j].append(i)
    seen=set(); best=[]
    for s0 in range(n):
        if s0 in seen: continue
        st=[s0]; comp=[]
        while st:
            k=st.pop()
            if k in seen: continue
            seen.add(k); comp.append(ids[k]); st+=[x for x in adj[k] if x not in seen]
        if len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    return best
